note: Model IDs were verified with `opencode models` on 2026-11-20. Existence is not capability: no role assignment is evidence-backed until scenario_bench records a score for that model on that role. PROVISIONAL entries require --allow-provisional.

openrouter.evidence: opencode models lists openrouter/anthropic/claude-fable-5.2 and openrouter/openai/gpt-6.2-astra; no authenticated invocation was made

coordinator.reason: coordination and root-cause work; family diversity against the independent critic

researcher.reason: independent literature and documentation research; external content is untrusted data

dependency-analyst.reason: mechanical impact and topology work; cost-efficient

logic-reviewer.reason: independent math, units and boundary review; different family from the architect

bug-hunter.reason: adversarial defect discovery before the change is approved

implementer.reason: single writer; coding ability must be measured by the scenario bench, not assumed

test-engineer.reason: test authoring; may not be the implementer

verifier.reason: narrative verification only; the PASS verdict itself comes from quality_gate, never from this model

rules: A PASS verdict is produced by quality_gate + decision.py, never by a model.
CRITICAL: architect family must differ from logic-reviewer family.
CRITICAL: implementer family must differ from verifier family.
One writer: exactly one node may hold the implementer role in a plan.
Premium models are used only on decision nodes (coordinator, architect, logic-reviewer, bug-hunter).
A role may only use a model whose ID was present in the probe for the selected provider.
PROVISIONAL assignments require --allow-provisional and are recorded as provisional in the plan.

budget.note: Context and output budgets are bounded per node; the host model prices are not guessed here.

benchmark.note: No role may claim a measured advantage before scenario_bench has produced a scorecard.
